description_en: Sets the recording lifecycle of an IPC device, which specifies the number of days that recording files are stored in the cloud
description_zh: 调用该接口，设置IPC设备的录像生命周期，即录像文件在云端存储的天数
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual set-device-record-life-cycle --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id d7XmBoJhAr88C6PelXDF000000 --day 7 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDeviceRecordLifeCycle

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view the information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The recording lifecycle, which specifies the number of days that recording files are retained in the cloud.

> You must set the recording lifecycle to a value greater than 0 to use other recording features provided by the video service. The maximum recording lifecycle is 3650 days
parameters.help_zh:
录像生命周期，即录像文件在云端保存的天数。

> 您需要设置录像生命周期大于0，才可使用视频服务提供的其他录像功能。录像生命周期最大可设置为3650天
parameters.name: day
